summary.title: Hacking with iOS Online
summary.one_liner: Learn Swift, UIKit and SwiftUI for iOS through a free, project-based tutorial series of 39 hands-on projects.
takeaways: Start with the Swift syntax introduction in Xcode playgrounds, then work through projects by interest.
Build hands-on apps and games covering UIKit, SwiftUI, Auto Layout, Core Data, SpriteKit and GameplayKit.
Check understanding with interactive tests (over 2000 questions) and additional challenges.
The free online edition omits the Xcode tips video, quick tips wall chart and other download-edition content.
summary.summary: Hacking with iOS is a free online tutorial series for learning Swift and iOS development, covering both UIKit and SwiftUI. It is organised as roughly 39 hands-on projects, from an introduction to Swift syntax through apps and games that teach topics such as Auto Layout, Core Data, SpriteKit, GameplayKit, CloudKit, and unit testing. The page also notes 30+ hours of video, interactive tests with over 2000 questions, and challenges, with a SwiftUI update adding 20 new projects. The free online edition leaves out some extras found in the paid download edition.
